title: El Dorado Was Never a City. It Was a Man on a Raft

characters.name: The Muisca Heir (don Juan)
characters.locked_description: a young Muisca heir of about twenty-five, a lean smooth face with high cheekbones, calm dark eyes, straight black hair cut at the shoulders, a slim upright build, a small gold ring through the nose

characters.name: Old don Juan
characters.locked_description: an old Muisca lord in his sixties, a deeply lined calm face, white hair cut straight at the shoulders, heavy-lidded dark eyes, a thin gold nose ring, a heavy red and ochre cotton mantle pinned at one shoulder

characters.name: The four Muisca chiefs
characters.locked_description: four Muisca chiefs, broad-shouldered men in their forties and fifties, each in a tall gold diadem with upright feather plumes, a wide gold breastplate and a thick cotton mantle woven in red, white and indigo stripes

characters.name: The Muisca crowd
characters.locked_description: a crowd of Muisca men and women in cotton mantles dyed red, ochre and indigo, feather headdresses, gold crowns, gold pendants and nose rings, dark straight hair, bare feet

characters.name: Juan Rodriguez Freyle
characters.locked_description: a lean Spanish colonial chronicler of about fifty, a long narrow face, deep-set dark eyes, a short pointed beard streaked with grey, a plain black doublet with a flat white collar, ink-stained fingers

characters.name: Sebastian de Belalcazar
characters.locked_description: a Spanish conquistador captain in his fifties, a weathered square face, a short grizzled beard, a steel morion helmet, a dented steel breastplate over a stained red-brown doublet, a sword belt at the hip

characters.name: Spanish conquistadors
characters.locked_description: Spanish conquistadors of the 1530s, bearded sunburned men in steel morion helmets, dented breastplates or quilted cotton jackets, leather boots, swords at the hip, one arquebus slung across a shoulder

characters.name: Sir Walter Raleigh
characters.locked_description: an Elizabethan adventurer in his forties, a tanned long face, a pointed brown beard and moustache, a pearl drop earring, a slashed black doublet with a small white ruff and a plumed hat

characters.name: Antonio de Sepulveda
characters.locked_description: a Spanish colonial merchant-engineer in his forties, a broad sunburned face, a dark pointed beard, a wide-brimmed felt hat, a worn leather jerkin over a white shirt with rolled sleeves

characters.name: The old Muisca priest
characters.locked_description: an old Muisca priest, a lean weathered face with deep lines, long grey hair tied back with a cotton band, a plain white cotton mantle, a small gold pendant on a cord, bare feet

locations.name: Lake Guatavita
locations.locked_description: a perfectly round mountain lake in a high Andean bowl, dark blue water ringed by steep walls of green paramo grass and low scrub, a narrow pale shore, thin mist along the rim, no building anywhere

locations.name: The heir's cave
locations.locked_description: a low dry cave in an Andean hillside, rough grey rock walls, a floor of woven reed mats, one small cooking fire, a rough opening onto cold highland slopes

locations.name: Freyle's study in Bogota
locations.locked_description: a small whitewashed adobe study in colonial Bogota in 1636, a heavy wooden desk with an inkwell and a thick bound ledger, one candle, a small shuttered window, a rough clay-tile floor

locations.name: Lake Teusaca
locations.locked_description: a small dark lake high in the paramo, black water under low cloud, a rim of tussock grass and furry frailejon plants, a rocky shore, bare windswept hills

key_props.name: The reed raft
key_props.locked_description: a great flat raft of bundled yellow reeds lashed with plaited cord, broad enough for six men, a raised bundled prow, a clay incense brazier standing at each of its four corners trailing grey smoke

key_props.name: The gold raft of Pasca
key_props.locked_description: a small cast-gold raft twenty centimetres long, a seated chief at the center with his arms crossed over his chest, ten smaller figures standing in a ring around him, some masked, a rough granular surface

key_props.name: The heap of gold and emeralds
key_props.locked_description: a heap of raw gold ornaments and green emeralds: flat gold figurines, discs, nose rings and rough nuggets mixed with rough uncut green emeralds, the gold soft and warm, the emeralds dark and glassy

notes: Samostalna epizoda, ideja #34 u docs/ideas.md, prva juznoamericka na kanalu (region South America, epoha Modern Era, dogadjaj c. 1537). Muisca, jezero Guatavita, Kolumbija. Glavni izvor je Freyle, El Carnero (1636), ceo spanski tekst procitan: cerimonija, post od sest godina u pecini, balsa od trske sa cetiri ziska, 'lepljiva zemlja' i zlatni prah, gomila zlata i smaragda pod nogama, cetiri poglavice, zastava za tisinu, Teusaca i svestenik. Narracija snimljena i poravnata (timing.json). 38 shotova (32 klipa + 6 slika), beat mapa odobrena, lockovi i storyboard upisani; vidi notes.md (osa ekrana, režim, šta ostaje). Rezim shota je mesan, birano iz kadra, ne iz kredita. Tacnost perioda: Muisca nisu Inke ni Asteci. Visoki andski paramo (hladno, magla, tresetna trava, jezero u kotlini), splav od trske (ne kanu, ne drveni brod), perje, zlatne krune i nakit, pamucni pokrivaci; nikakav kameni grad ni piramida. Spanci 1530-ih: celicni sljem (morion), kiraska, pas; Raleigh: elizabetinska odeca. Raft iz Pasce (Museo del Oro): 19.5 cm, jedanaest figura, centralni poglavica sedi na duhu sa rukama preko grudi, deset manjih, neke maskirane; lost-wax u jednom izlivanju; to je predmet za krupni plan. Pozlacen covek: telo prekriveno zlatnim prahom od glave do pete, prikazati iz daljine, sa leda ili u dimu, bez anatomije (nikad golo telo u kadru). Cerimonija je ljudska skala, ali velika scena (dim, vatre, rulja po obali, zastava); nije mit sa bogovima. Tacnost: Freyle NE pominje ronjenje u jezero ni suprugu koja se udavila; to ne crtati kao Freyleovo. Pazi: cerimoniju ne prikazivati kao nesto sto su Spanci gledali; nijedan Spanac je nije video. Brojke 'hiljade mrtvih' nisu potvrdjene, ne ide u naslov ni opis. 'Dvanaest hiljada pesosa' je Sepulvedina sopstvena tvrdnja. Protagonists za publish.md se upisuju pre naslova: naslov ne imenuje nikog (El Dorado je legenda) ili imenuje sve glavne (Freyle, Belalcazar, Raleigh, Sepulveda), nikad jednog + deo.
